Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental logical error in the very first step of the conversation. The task asks to identify the film whose director is **younger**. The Planner correctly identified the directors (Reginald Le Borg born in 1902 and Hervé Bromberger born in 1918) but incorrectly concluded in the final step that the person born in 1902 (Le Borg) is the "younger" director. In reality, a person born in 1902 is older than a person born in 1918. This error in comparing birth years (interpreting "younger" as "born earlier" instead of "born later") led to the wrong solution.
